packageRules.description: Keep the final image on the Corretto 21 LTS line. The JRE the scanner runs on is a product compatibility statement, not a dependency bump (see SCANDOCKER-69 for the 17 -> 21 move), so a major upgrade needs its own ticket and QA. Patch-level JDK fixes and Amazon Linux security errata still reach the image on every rebuild, because the 21-al2023 tag is refreshed upstream continuously and is resolved at build time rather than pinned here.
